### Presurance Holdings Reports 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results


November 12, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/790597683/files/doc_news/Presurance-Holdings-Reports-2026-Third-Quarter-Financial-Results-2026.pdf)


TROY, Mich., Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- **Presurance Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: PRHI)** (“Presurance” or the “Company”) today reported financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026.


**Third Quarter & YTD 2026 Financial Highlights**


- Personal Lines Business Continues to Generate Profitable Underwriting Results


- Combined ratio for Q3 2026 improved to 82.7% from 95.2% in the prior year period.
- YTD 2026 combined ratio of 91.0%; a significant improvement from 119.3% for the first nine months of 2025.


- Improved YTD Overall Underwriting Performance


- Overall underwriting combined ratio improved to 97.1% for the nine months ending September 30, 2026, compared to 133.7% in the prior-year period.


- Book value is now $6.45 per share as of September 30, 2026.


**Management Comments**


“During the third quarter, we continued to execute our overall strategic priorities while addressing the remaining obligations associated with our legacy portfolio,” said Brian Roney, Chief Executive Officer of Presurance Holdings, Inc. “We are pleased to report lessening legacy impacts, as our ongoing core Personal Lines business continues to perform profitably.”

* The "Definitions of Non-GAAP Measures" section of this release defines and reconciles data that are not based on generally accepted accounting principles.


** Percentage is not meaningful


(1) The loss ratio is the ratio, expressed as a percentage, of net losses and loss adjustment expenses to net earned premiums.


(2) The expense ratio is the ratio, expressed as a percentage, of policy acquisition costs and segment operating expenses to net earned premiums.


(3) The combined ratio is the sum of the loss ratio and the expense ratio. A combined ratio under 100% indicates an underwriting profit. A combined ratio over 100% indicates an underwriting loss.


**2026 Third Quarter Gross Written Premium**


Gross written premiums decreased 57.8% to $6.2 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $14.6 million in the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ending September 30, 2026, gross written premiums decreased 40.8% to $30.7 million, compared to $51.9 million in the prior-year period.


The reduction in premium volume reflects the Company's continued emphasis on underwriting discipline, and selective risk acceptance in potentially softening market conditions. The Company remains focused on its personal lines homeowners business while continuing to manage its legacy Commercial Lines portfolio in runoff.


Certain reserve strengthening in the third quarter of 2026 was largely due to development experienced solely in the legacy run-off book of business.

Personal Lines gross written premiums decreased 44.6% to $6.2 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $11.2 million in the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, Personal Lines gross written premiums decreased 28.8% to $30.7 million, compared to $43.2 million in the prior-year period.


Following the decision to non-renew its Midwest homeowners business, the Company's Personal Lines portfolio now consists exclusively of Texas homeowners policies going forward.


This transition further focuses the Company's geographic and underwriting footprint and reinforces its commitment to a dedicated operating model centered on disciplined risk selection and overall profitability.

The Company's Commercial Lines portfolio remains in runoff, with no ongoing new business production. Reserve strengthening during the third quarter of 2026 was largely attributable to adverse development largely within the Company's discontinued Security Guard book of business.


Performance within this portfolio further underscores the importance of maintaining a disciplined approach to legacy exposures and active claims management of discontinued business. The Company remains focused on prudent reserve management, and reducing / mitigating the impact of historical Commercial Lines exposures on future financial results.

The Company's underwriting combined ratio was 113.2% for the third quarter of 2026, compared to 141.2% for the same period in 2025, largely impacted by select reserve strengthening in the quarter.


For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company's overall underwriting combined ratio improved significantly to 97.1%, compared to 133.7% in the prior-year period. This reflects continued progress in the Company's ongoing underwriting operations, partially offset by reserve strengthening associated with its discontinued Commercial Lines portfolio.


The year-to-date improvement reflects the continued benefit of the Company's refined underwriting strategy and more focused Personal Lines portfolio.


**Net Investment Income**


Net investment income was $1.1 million for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, compared to $1.3 million in the prior year period.


**Change in Fair Value of Equity Securities**


During the quarter, the Company reported no change in the fair value of its equity securities, compared to a gain of $13,000 in the prior year period.


**Net Income (Loss) allocable to common shareholders**


The Company reported a net loss allocable to common shareholders of $1.6 million, or $0.43 per share, for the third quarter of 2026.


**Adjusted Operating Income (Loss)**


The Company reported an adjusted operating loss of $1.6 million, or $0.42 per share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to an adjusted operating loss of $2.7 million, or $1.55 per share, for the same period in 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company reported an adjusted operating loss of $1.2 million, or $0.36 per share, compared to an adjusted operating loss of $8.5 million, or $4.85 per share for the same period in 2025. See Definitions of Non-GAAP Measures.


**About Presurance Holdings**


Presurance Holdings, Inc. is a specialty insurance property and casualty holding company with a focus on disciplined growth and long-term value creation. The Company trades on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol PRHI. Additional information can be found on the Company’s website at IR.PREHLD.com.


**Definitions of Non-GAAP Measures**


Presurance prepares its public financial statements in conformity with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (GAAP). Statutory data is prepared in accordance with statutory accounting rules as defined by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners' (NAIC) Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual and therefore is not reconciled to GAAP data.


We believe that investors’ understanding of the Company’s performance is enhanced by our disclosure of adjusted operating income. Our method of calculating this measure may differ from that used by other companies and therefore comparability may be limited. We define adjusted operating income (loss), a non-GAAP measure, as net income (loss) excluding: 1) net realized investment gains (losses), 2) change in fair value of equity securities, 3) change in fair value of contingent considerations, 4) contingent consideration bonus expense and 5) additional accretion of warrants from Series B Preferred Stock payoff. We use adjusted operating income as an internal performance measure in the management of our operations because we believe it gives our management and other users of our financial information useful insight into the results of our operations and underlying business performance.
